sources.title: Qwen3-1.7B-GGUF Open-source AI Model - Supports Multiple Quantization ...
sources.snippet: This is the GGUF format version of the Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B model, quantized by MaziyarPanahi. GGUF is a new format developed by the llama.cpp team to replace the GGML format. It supports various quantization levels (from 2-bit to 8-bit), facilitating deployment and operation on various hardware.
